On Oct 12th, the committee met to officially accept the addition of Kristin Gaarder and Tracy Ericksen to the committee.

With all 5 members present, Kelly Chermack was elected as President and Tom Stockert was elected as both Treasurer and Secretary.

The other item of business was a review of plans - including this website and petition timeline.
